parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal wooden shelf inside the cabinet used for supporting stored items.
parts.Functional_description: Provides a flat surface to hold objects such as books, dishes, or decorative items.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: Another internal wooden shelf providing additional storage space.
parts.Functional_description: Supports items placed inside the cabinet, dividing the internal space.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A wooden door panel attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: Allows access to the interior shelves and protects contents from dust.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The second door panel of the cabinet, forming the other half of the front closure.
parts.Functional_description: Provides access to the cabinet’s interior and closes to conceal stored items.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet that supports all other parts.
parts.Functional_description: Provides rigidity and stability to the entire cabinet structure.
parts.Movement_description: Stationary and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The bottom shelf of the cabinet providing base-level storage.
parts.Functional_description: Supports heavier items placed at the bottom of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: Fixed in place, does not move during normal use.
